body:
So after a few days of research, my friend and I tried snorting yopo snuff. we were expecting a nice trip with hallucinations, and were both excited. He snorted 2 small lines, ~2.5 seeds, and didn't want to do his last big line. I, however, did 4 lines,  ~4.5 seeds. After a few minutes of burning and holding back newly formed black snot, we decided that this did not work at all. After many hours, nothing changed. We both promise to never put anything else up our nose.
